d: In this video, Firstpost examines growing discontent among Microsoft employees over CEO Satya Nadella's AI-first strategy. In an open letter, current and former workers describe the workplace as 'joyless and demoralising', accusing the company of prioritising AI investments over employees, customers and its wider commitments. They raise concerns about layoffs, crushing workloads, forced adoption of AI tools and declining trust within the organisation.
